## Description

After playing the same session of VRChat for several hours in one sitting, you eventually stop receiving incoming notifications. Notifications like invites, invite requests, boops, etc. will not be forwarded and pushed out. Friends being online will also desync. For example, with this bug, if a friend was online, then goes offline during the experience of this bug, you will still see them as online until you view their profile. It will then correct itself accordingly. Another thing to note is another problem if you're on the open beta builds of VRChat, where the Social UI overhaul is in place. While experiencing this desync bug, you are not able to view people's profiles on the big menu. It'll just display absolutely nothing.

## Reproduction Steps

Play the game in one session for a brief period of time, no restarting, and you'll eventually experience it. You won't recieve notifications from people trying to invite you and such. The ONLY workaround I found to temporarily fix this problem is to simply restart the game.

## Details

- Category: Networking

- Frequency: Always
